_doc: Published deterministic test vector for the GitCellar chunk-format v1 (F2, XChaCha20-Poly1305) with the H-1 chunk-identity AAD binding. A third party reproduces `chunk_hex` bit-for-bit from (content_key_hex, nonce_hex, plaintext_utf8, aad) with any XChaCha20-Poly1305 implementation, and reproduces content_key_hex from (k_repo_hex, content_key_info) with any HKDF-SHA256. The AEAD associated data is `aad.cipher_aad_hex` = format_version_byte(1) || repo_id || 0x00 || chunk_name || 0x00 || stream_offset(u64 LE) || size(u64 LE); the AAD is NOT stored in the chunk — it only participates in the Poly1305 tag. Generated from source via `cargo test -p vault-core gen_published_test_vector -- --ignored --nocapture`; never hand-edited.
aad_layout: version_byte(1) || repo_id || 0x00 || chunk_name || 0x00 || stream_offset(u64 LE) || size(u64 LE)  (associated data only; not stored)
plaintext_utf8: GitCellar chunk-format v1 published test vector
